title: An ADR that lets SOBER reach an OpenAI-compatible endpoint itself, with its own tool loop
name: api-loop-adr
description: ADR 0061 says 'SOBER gains no API client and no tool loop', and DESIGN §5.1 says 'it never asks for an API key'. Both are reversed on purpose: OpenCode is the only way SOBER reaches OpenRouter today, its probe fails from inside the MCP server, and every extra model on the board is an OpenRouter one. Write docs/adr/0062-sober-reaches-an-openai-compatible-endpoint-itself.md (Status accepted, Refines 0061, 0058): the `openrouter` host is served by SOBER's own loop against the OpenAI chat-completions format, OpenRouter by default and any OpenAI-compatible base URL by setting; the key comes from `.sober/.env` (`OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, and `OPENAI_API_KEY`-style names per base URL are out of scope — one variable); the host CLIs stay the way to reach Claude, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode's other providers. Record the two bound decisions' answers in the ADR. Update DESIGN §5.1's sentence and the 'A provider is a command line' paragraph of ADR 0061 with a one-line pointer to 0062. No code.

brief.approach:
Three documents, no code.

1. `docs/adr/0062-sober-reaches-an-openai-compatible-endpoint-itself.md`, in the shape of `docs/adr/0058-a-tier-names-its-host-and-model.md`: title line `# 0062 — SOBER reaches an OpenAI-compatible endpoint itself`, then `Status: accepted`, `Date: 2026-09-21`, `Refines: DESIGN §5.1, [ADR 0058](…), [ADR 0061](…)`. Context: DESIGN §5.1 says "It never asks for an API key" and "calling a model API directly … makes SOBER an agent framework … a different product"; ADR 0061 says "SOBER gains no API client and no tool loop". What changed: every extra model on the board is an OpenRouter one, OpenCode is the only road to it, and OpenCode's `providers list` probe fails from inside the MCP server (`could not report its authentication status`) so those models cannot start at all. Decision, four paragraphs: (a) `openrouter` is a fifth host, served by SOBER's own loop against the OpenAI chat-completions format — OpenRouter by default, any OpenAI-compatible base URL by a setting on the entry; the four host CLIs stay the road to everything else. (b) The loop runs as a `sober agent` subprocess that the adapter table spawns like every other host, printing one JSON event per line — decision `where-does-sober-s-own-tool-loop-run-in-i1nr`, answered `subprocess`; give its two options and why in-process lost (two launch paths in `host.ts`, a hung fetch hangs the dispatcher). (c) On 429 and 5xx the loop retries a bounded number of times with backoff and says so in the log; anything else fails at once with the status — decision `when-the-endpoint-refuses-mid-run-a-429-8q5u`, answered `bounded-retry`; name `fail-fast` and `next-model` and why they lost (the second leaks model choice out of Jev and overlaps `backup-8erx`). (d) The key is `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, read from `.sober/.env` the way `JEV_API_KEY` is (`packages/core/src/env.ts`) — one variable, whatever the base URL. Consequences: SOBER now owns a tool loop and the four tools it exposes, which §5.1 called a different product — say that the sentence still holds for the CLI hosts and what the loop is *not* (no sandbox beyond the worktree, no MCP, no skills); the `sober` binary must be on the PATH the MCP server sees, the same requirement `sober mcp` already has. Alternatives rejected: keep OpenCode and fix its probe (the probe is not the only failure — a run's `--model openrouter/...` still depends on OpenCode's own provider config); Cline as the road to OpenRouter (a third CLI in the way of a URL). Keep to the length of 0061.

2. `docs/adr/0061-a-model-is-named-and-jev-picks-among-them.md`: at the end of the "A provider is a command line" paragraph, one sentence: "ADR 0062 adds one host that is SOBER's own — `openrouter` — reached by `sober agent`, which is still a command line."

3. `docs/DESIGN.md` §5.1: replace "It never asks for an API key." with a sentence that says the four CLI hosts never do, and that the `openrouter` host takes one from `.sober/.env` (ADR 0062). Extend the "Calling a model API directly was the alternative" paragraph with the same pointer. Do not touch the adapter table — the `openrouter` column is the `openrouter-host-bdws` node's, when the flags exist.

Nothing in `packages/`; no numbering change (0062 is free: `ls docs/adr` ends at 0061).

acceptance.proves: The ADR exists under the next free number and is accepted, in the header shape of 0058

acceptance.run: rg -q 'subprocess' docs/adr/0062-*.md && rg -q -i 'retr' docs/adr/0062-*.md && rg -q 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY' docs/adr/0062-*.md
acceptance.proves: Both bound decisions' answers and the key's name are recorded in the ADR

acceptance.run: rg -q '0062' docs/adr/0061-a-model-is-named-and-jev-picks-among-them.md && rg -q '0062' docs/DESIGN.md && ! rg -q 'It never asks for an API key\.' docs/DESIGN.md
acceptance.proves: 0061 and DESIGN §5.1 point at 0062 and the reversed sentence is gone

acceptance.run: git diff --stat development -- packages | rg -q . && exit 1 || exit 0
acceptance.proves: No code changed — the node is documents only
biome and secretlint are green on the docs
